value.rationale: This exact four-orbit characterization resolves the natural joint questions of irredundant seed size, geometric placement and synchronous time at the first cube dimension where minimal percolating seeds have unequal sizes. The unique maximal-delay-preserving augmentation map explains nontrivial coupling between minimality and speed, with 96 distinct redundant slow four-seeds. A complete naturally motivated finite classification has value independently of any general theorem.
